seoTitle: AI Block Adoption Timeline from robots.txt Snapshots
metaDescription: Paste dated robots.txt snapshots and see when each AI crawler was first blocked or unblocked. Free, runs in your browser.
intro: Reads a series of dated robots.txt copies and shows when AI crawlers were blocked or unblocked.
why:
A site's AI policy changes over time. Archived copies of its robots.txt, taken on different dates, show when it started blocking GPTBot or ClaudeBot.

Paste snapshots after === date lines and read the first block date per crawler and the list of changes. Fetching archived copies needs the network, so copy them yourself. A bot that did not exist yet cannot be blocked, so early snapshots show nothing for it.
howTo: Collect robots.txt copies from different dates.
Paste each after a === date line.

faq.a: Any that sort as text, such as 2024-05-01.
It was never blocked in the snapshots.
The home page is disallowed for it.
